title: Tree vs sequential summation error bound (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
1024 elements: x[0]=1.0, x[1..1023]=1e-15 each -- an extreme dynamic-range fixture.
Reference 'true' value is computed with math.fsum (exact summation), immune to the rounding error this task measures.
A left-to-right sequential accumulation of the same array measures rel_err ~= 1.13e-13 on this fixture, over 10x the gate -- the tree reduction measures rel_err = 0.0.
